usedFor: Autoboat sends messages to contacts through your Autoboat account, using “Send Message” or “Send Template Message” for pre-approved templates.

bestTemplate.name: “Send Template Message” in Autoboat
bestTemplate.why: It sends a pre-approved template to a contact, so the wording is settled before a run starts.

watchOut: Messages sent through your Autoboat account reach people outside your team, so each one waits for your approval first.
